//: Core LaunchAgents install.sh renders with render.ts. {bun} = the bun binary, {home} = the data folder (OMODORI_HOME / paths.dataDir), {logdir} = paths.logDir (default ~/Library/Logs/omodori), {logs} = {logdir}/core, {dir} = this core folder (also the working directory). Label = <launchd.prefix>.<name> from config.json. launchd.services in config.json picks which ones are installed. Messenger sources bring their own templates (sources/<name>/manifest.json launchAgents), installed by `omodori onboard <name>`.
